messages:
Amy (PM): heads up 10min sync: propose a 2-week micro-iteration to clean up highest-impact post-launch items. main goal = protect SLAs while shipping small UX wins.
Sam (Eng): sounds good. what's in-scope?
Amy (PM): short list (opinionated):
````
- A: streaming-edge crash (P0) 1 owner: Sam. hotfix + canary.
- B: prefix-cache eviction causing latency spikes (P1) 1 owner: Sam. fix + unit/regression test.
- C: billing-export missing rows for large customers (P1) 1 owner: Rajesh. backend fix + customer validation.
- D: snippet truncation UX (P2) 1 owner: Lina. small polish behind flag.
- E: add two regression replay tests (QA) 1 owner: Jess.
````
Jess (QA): need acceptance criteria for A and C. otherwise can't clear canary.
Amy (PM): agreed. acceptance: A = zero crash reports for affected call path for 24h at 100% traffic OR error rate <=0.01% and synthetic replay passes 100%. C = export contains >=99.9% of rows in canary vs baseline over 24h and customer confirms sample.
Sam (Eng): rough estimate: A = 2d (patch + canary), B = 1.5d, C = 1.5d including validation. D = 0.5d, E = 1d. with parallel work total ~4 dev-days.
Lina (Design): can prototype D tonight, will keep behind feature flag.
Rajesh (CS): i can repro the billing case with the reporting customer once you have a canary. prefer 24h customer validation window.
Jess (QA): will add replay harness and a lightweight long-tail latency test for B. need a dev seed and repro for A.
Sam (Eng): quick ask: freeze non-critical infra/config PRs during canary to keep metrics stable.
Amy (PM): ok freeze for slice window. i'll notify eng-infra and release-war-room.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary started 10% for commit def456 on us-west-1
Jess (QA): got an alert after 15m on canary CPU spike, investigating logs.
Sam (Eng): enabled extra tracing on the streaming path; if noise persists we throttle canary to 5% and roll back.
Rajesh (CS): drafting customer note: short status + mitigation steps (temporary workaround: reduce batch size) and expected ETA for fix. will send draft here.
Lina (Design): small UX tweak looks low-risk behind flag. no blocking comments.
Amy (PM): decision checklist: owners assigned, acceptance criteria set, infra freeze OK, canary plan live. next steps: I'll create a JIRA sprint-slice ticket and link it. react with :thumbsup: to confirm owners/order. :eyes: for questions.
Sam (Eng): :thumbsup:
Jess (QA): :thumbsup:
Rajesh (CS): :thumbsup:
Lina (Design): :thumbsup:
Amy (PM): will open jira now and update the prod runbook entry for the streaming incident. ping release-war-room when canary reaches 50% for final go/no-go.
